tests.name: sensor-config-present
tests.description: do-harness.toml defines the workspace sensor pack

tests.name: six-core-sensors
tests.description: fmt, check, clippy, test, deny, loc sensors are configured
tests.exec: for s in fmt check clippy test deny loc; do rg -q "name = \"$s\"" do-harness.toml || exit 1; done

tests.name: loc-sensor-script
tests.description: check-loc.sh sensor script exists and is executable

tests.name: workflow-step-ten
tests.description: Change Workflow step 10 runs do-harness verify --record

tests.name: dev-harness-section
tests.description: AGENTS.md documents the Dev Harness (do-harness) section

tests.name: hook-ownership-guard
tests.description: Documents that pre-commit framework owns .git/hooks (no do-harness hook install)
tests.exec: rg -q 'Do NOT run \`?do-harness hook install' AGENTS.md
